releases.name: Sad Damn
releases.summary: Sad Damn is hiding. Use your fortress to blast your way to him. Tear through his generals' defenses, get better weapons, and try not to get blown up first.

releases.name: Hivemind
releases.summary: Hivemind is a free online party game where players give clues, guess hidden targets on fun spectrums, and score points by thinking alike. Perfect for game nights, remote hangouts, icebreakers, and quick laughs with friends.

releases.name: Eggsecution Squad
releases.summary: Eggsecution Squad is a fast, chaotic egg brawler for up to 4 players — local or online. Grab 14+ wild weapons, dash, block and punch across 5 maps, and knock the other eggs off or kill them. Last egg standing wins. Dress your egg up and beat up your friends (in game).

releases.name: SHAME
releases.summary: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

releases.name: A Cruise for Murder
releases.summary: A 3D modern remake of the classic Cruise for a Corpse, along with original music, different plot and 15 puzzles.

releases.name: Void Squadron
releases.summary: Fight, mine, and build your squadron in a 3D space-combat roguelike. Turn asteroid ore into upgrades, weapons, and AI wingmates. Recruit miners, protectors, and attack ships, tear down pirate bases, destroy alien motherships, and push your build through escalating waves.

releases.name: Last House Standing
releases.summary: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

releases.name: Dungeon Inn
releases.summary:
As Sara, the ambitious innkeeper, you’ve struck a deal with a dragon to open an inn right next to a mysterious dungeon that appeared near the dragon's lair. With adventurers from rival guilds eager to explore the dungeon’s secrets, your inn has become the perfect pit stop for them.

Your challenge? Keep these competing groups from crossing paths while maximizing profits. It’s a delicate balancing act, but who cares if they’re rivals? As long as we don’t get caught, everyone’s happy - especially your coin purse!

Welcome to the art of dungeon-adjacent hospitality, where discretion meets ambition, and every guest is a potential goldmine. Let the games begin!

releases.name: Biden Blast
releases.summary: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

releases.name: Want a Bomb?
releases.summary: Blow up mountains with your friends in this chaotic online co-op game. Collect minerals, buy bigger explosives, build chains of explosions, and experiment with bomb-loaded drones, explosive baseballs, and a launcher that can send your friends flying.

releases.name: Fitness Club Simulator 2027
releases.summary:
Build, manage, expand, and take your gym to the top.

Turn a small gym into the next fitness sensation and build a business that makes an impact across the city. Start with a simple space, make smart investments, and transform your first location into a thriving destination where people come to train, improve, and reach their goals. Every decision shapes your success as you turn ambition into a growing fitness empire.

Explore the city, discover new opportunities, and open additional gyms in different locations. Design each space your way, upgrade your facilities, manage your staff, and create a recognizable brand that keeps attracting new clients. Balance your finances, reputation, and daily operations as your business grows from a modest gym into a name the entire city knows.

Key Features:
• Build Your Fitness Empire: Start with one gym and expand your business across the city.
• Design Unique Gyms: Customize layouts, equipment, atmosphere, and the overall look of every location.
• Upgrade and Expand: Invest in better equipment, new facilities, and additional areas to unlock new possibilities.
• Manage Your Business: Hire staff, control expenses, and make strategic decisions to keep your gyms running efficiently.
• Create Your Brand: Develop a distinctive fitness identity and build a reputation that attracts more clients.

releases.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
releases.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

releases.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
releases.summary:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest is an immersive action-adventure game set in the Lake Territories of the beloved Warrior Cats book series.

Embark on a variety of quests to gain favor with your Clan and battle others in turn-based combat to strengthen your cat and grow your legend. Learn new combat moves to take down your rivals. Encounter a wide range of enemies, including mice, squirrels, badgers and more, all leading to epic battles. 

Forage the land and find materials that can be used to craft items in your den. Travel across iconic territories including ThunderClan’s dense forests, RiverClan’s marshlands, ShadowClan’s dark pine swamps, and WindClan’s open moors. Your adventure will also take you to the famed sacred locations The Moonpool and The Island. 

Climb trees, pounce through undergrowth, track scents, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover the mysteries of StarClan itself.
